title: 'git vouch export': allowed_signers and revocation file
description: From check's result write allowed_signers: email principals, namespaces="git,file" ("file" for automation, only with --include-automation), valid-after from added, valid-before from retired or tier-removal date. --min-tier anchor|maintainer|contributor. Write gpg.ssh.revocationFile from revocations.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end test: git verify-tag accepts a maintainer tag with --min-tier maintainer and rejects a contributor tag; automation key fails git namespace; revoked key fails; retired key verifies a signature made before retirement.
notes:
DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22): tier-removal date comes from git. Deletion: valid-before = committer date of the deleting commit (only a record that verified at its parent commit). Demotion: higher tier ends at the new signed record's date. ALSO per DESIGN.md 2026-10-22: every exported line's principals = handle first, then endorsed emails only (D2); --include-automation flag on export; automation lines namespaces="file".
REVIEW FIXES (2026-10-22): (1) A tier replaced by a record without effect (void/invalid) ends like a deletion, at the replacing commit's committer date, since a void record has no effect (DESIGN.md Removal: earlier signatures stay valid). (2) A tier replaced across the automation line ends at the new record's date, like a demotion; the walk always continues back. OWNER QUESTION: confirm record date vs committer date for crossing automation. (3) Export writes two lines for a key whose human tier ended while it is current automation (git,file expired + file with --include-automation); OpenSSH 9.6 verified to honour each line's namespaces/validity independently in either order. (4) DECISION: an uncommitted deletion ends the tier at now, because check judges the working tree as if committed next (History docstring); alternative rejected: treat as not yet effective, which would need check to judge the working tree by HEAD for tiers only. Normal export runs on a synced (committed) checkout, so valid-before only moves while a deletion is uncommitted. (5) Committer times kept as ints and converted only where used; out-of-range dates raise VouchError (also in file_history, which crashed the same way).
